alert.name: ECSServiceAlarm
alert.summary: CloudWatch alarm fired for ECS service checkout

tool_errors: logs: logs: /ecs/checkout: An error occurred (AccessDeniedException) when calling the FilterLogEvents operation: User: <ARN_1> is not authorized to perform

root_cause.hypothesis: Alarm looks like transient/flapping trigger, not real outage. Task count matches desired (2/2), no pending/failed deploys, CPU near-idle (~0.5%), memory moderate (~65%). One deployment in-flight with zero failures suggests routine rolling deploy mid-flight when alarm fired, not degradation. No logs or deploy history provided to pin exact trigger (likely a brief threshold breach on CPU/mem or ECS deployment-state metric that self-cleared).
evidence: tasks_running == tasks_desired == 2 (service healthy, no capacity loss)

proposal.reasoning: tasks_running=tasks_desired=2, no pending/failed deploys, CPU ~0.5%, mem ~65%. Metrics healthy; one deployment in-flight likely caused transient alarm state that self-clears. No logs/evidence of real degradation.
proposal.expected_effect: No change; alarm expected to clear once in-flight deployment completes. Monitor for recurrence.
